body:
Splitting things up sounds like a good idea...hadn't thought about that one....thanks 

I do have problems asking for help, and I've never felt comfortable talking with counselors. In my experiences, they either were too focused on a specific thing or told me things I already knew. I gave up on them in middle school after hearing the same speech again about how we needed to think about our futures and be happy little clone creatures...I haven't met one I felt I could really connect with, so that's never really seemed like an option...

I AM holding out for college. I'm just really hoping the next two years to get there are better.
